title: Moon Mystery
provenance: Reported by Swiss-Mac-User (highball#381, highball#382, highball-db#547, 2026-10-18), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.19, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28: works on DXMT (one crash when a Steam achievement triggered, not repeatable, and Steam's overlay FPS counter drawn as a black square), rated 4 of 5 on D3DMetal (resolution capped at 1440 pixels, low graphics forced), and DXVK crashes when a save loads (a pipeline with a geometry shader fails to compile in MoltenVK). Not verified by the maintainer. Swiss-Mac-User again on highball#659 (2026-11-06), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.26, the Wine 11 engine x64-crossover26.3-r29, graphics mode not stated: runs like a charm at 3200x1800 fullscreen, a solid 60 fps and more, with occasional lags while shaders load. An earlier failure to start (CreateProcess() returned 2 for MoonMystery-Win64-Shipping.exe) was a half-empty game folder after the Steam library moved to another drive, which Steam's Verify integrity of game files fixed.
notes: Works on DXMT, the default mode, with full graphics. D3DMetal caps the resolution and forces low settings, and DXVK crashes when loading a game. On an M5 Pro with the Wine 11 engine r29 it runs at 60 fps and more at 3200x1800 fullscreen, with occasional lags while shaders load (highball#659).

knownIssues.symptom: Crash when loading a game on DXVK
knownIssues.cause: a render pipeline with a geometry shader fails to compile in MoltenVK (Metal has no geometry shaders)

knownIssues.symptom: Resolution capped at 1440 pixels and low graphics forced on D3DMetal
Steam overlay's FPS counter shows a black square
Doesn't start, "CreateProcess() returned 2" for MoonMystery-Win64-Shipping.exe (after moving the Steam library to another drive)
knownIssues.cause: the game's folder was left without most of its files
knownIssues.fix: in Steam open the game's Properties, Installed Files, Verify integrity of game files (highball#659, credit Swiss-Mac-User)
